bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. A distorted, overdriven kick drum drives the rhythm at 130 BPM in 4/4 time. A resonant, metallic synth bass sequence alternates between a steady eighth-note pulse and syncopated sixteenth-note patterns. High-frequency industrial textures, including white noise bursts and metallic clangs, function as percussion. A dark, filtered sawtooth lead synth enters with a repetitive, minor-key three-note motif. Periodic bit-crushed vocal samples are processed through heavy delay and ring modulation, rendering them as rhythmic textures rather than melodic lines. The arrangement features sudden low-pass filter sweeps on the master bus and gated reverb on the snare-like industrial hits.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum enters, four-on-the-floor]
[metallic percussion hits with long reverb tails]

[Section A]
[pulsing synth bass enters, eighth-note pattern]
[high-frequency white noise hats]
[distorted vocal textures, heavily processed]

[Section B]
[resonant sawtooth lead synth enters, minor-key motif]
[syncopated sixteenth-note bass variations]
[bit-crushed industrial clangs]

[Breakdown]
[kick drum drops out]
[low-pass filter sweep on synth lead]
[atmospheric drone swells]

[Outro]
[kick drum re-enters]
[instruments gradually fade out via high-cut filter]
[final distorted kick hit]

drums.tags: Industrial techno with a heavy, distorted aesthetic. A distorted kick drum drives the rhythm with a resonant, overdriven sub-tail. A metallic, percussive synth sequence provides a constant, syncopated sixteenth-note pattern. High-frequency white noise bursts and filtered industrial textures create rhythmic accents. A resonant, acid-style synth lead enters with a sweeping low-pass filter. The tempo is 140 BPM in the key of D minor. The track features a minimalist, repetitive structure focused on timbral evolution and rhythmic density.

vocals.tags: Ambient drone with heavy cinematic sound design. A low-frequency sub-bass pulse oscillates at approximately 60 BPM. Layered over the sub-bass are metallic, resonant textures that shift in timbre through manual filter sweeps and granular synthesis. High-frequency shimmering pads with long decay times create a sense of vast space. Periodic mechanical whirring and industrial clangs occur at irregular intervals, processed with deep hall reverb and stereo delays. The harmonic content is static, centered around a dark, dissonant tonal center. No rhythmic percussion or melodic leads are present.
